title: Diagnosing Conformal Prediction Failures Under Distribution Shift: A COVID-19 Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2601.00908v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but these degrade under distribution shift - and practitioners lack tools to anticipate which deployed models will fail before observing test data. We propose SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) concentration - the fraction of feature importance concentrated in the top feature - as a pre-deployment diagnostic for conformal prediction vulnerability in gradient-boosted classifiers. Using COVID-19 as a naturalistic case study, eight supply chain tasks experience identical temporal shift yet coverage drops ranging from negligible to catastrophic. Feature-importance concentration is strongly associated with failure severity across 16 multiclass tasks in 9 domains, while standard distributional shift detectors detect shift uniformly across tasks but cannot distinguish catastrophic from robust outcomes. translated_title: 诊断分布偏移下共形预测的失败：一项COVID-19案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.00908v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：共形预测提供了无分布的覆盖保证，但在分布偏移下这些保证会退化——而实践者在观察到测试数据之前，缺乏工具来预测哪些已部署的模型会失败。我们提出SHapley加性解释（SHAP）集中度——即特征重要性集中在顶部特征中的比例——作为梯度提升分类器中共形预测脆弱性的部署前诊断指标。以COVID-19作为自然案例研究，八个供应链任务经历了相同的时间偏移，但覆盖率的下降从可忽略不计到灾难性不等。在9个领域的16个多类任务中，特征重要性集中度与失败严重性密切相关，而标准的分布偏移检测器在任务间均匀地检测到偏移，但无法区分灾难性结果与稳健结果。在9个非供应链数据集上的外部验证显示……
tldr: 本文提出SHAP集中度作为共形预测在分布偏移下脆弱性的部署前诊断指标，并在COVID-19案例中证明其能有效区分灾难性失败与稳健结果，优于传统偏移检测器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SHAP concentration as a pre-deployment diagnostic for conformal prediction vulnerability under distribution shift, demonstrating in a COVID-19 case study that it effectively distinguishes catastrophic failures from robust outcomes, outperforming standard shift detectors.
